targets.query: SELECT ip,mean("resp") FROM "def"."vm.health" WHERE ("id" =~ /^$UUID$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.description: vGPU compute workload % of this VM, as reported by the host. Sampled every 5 minutes: a workload shorter than that may not appear. MIG-backed vGPUs report no utilization; pGPU (passthrough) VMs have no GPU data.
panels.title: GPU Usage

panels.description: Total is the framebuffer of this VM's vGPU. Used is what the host driver reports for the vGPU: it does not follow allocations inside the guest in real time and can stay at the idle value while a workload runs. Sampled every 5 minutes. pGPU (passthrough) VMs have no GPU data.
panels.title: Memory Usage

panels.description: vGPU encoder utilization % of this VM, as reported by the host. Sampled every 5 minutes: a workload shorter than that may not appear.
panels.title: Encoder Usage

panels.description: vGPU decoder utilization % of this VM, as reported by the host. Sampled every 5 minutes: a workload shorter than that may not appear.
panels.title: Decoder Usage
Provisioned
panels.description: Disk size as provisioned: what the VM was promised.

panels.title: Allocated
panels.description: Bytes the backend physically holds. Thin provisioning never shrinks, so this stays high after the guest deletes files unless discard passed through.

panels.title: Guest filesystem used
panels.description: What df reports inside the guest. Blank when the guest agent does not answer -- that is 'not measured', not 'empty'.

panels.title: Thin ratio
panels.description: Provisioned over physically allocated. On CubeCOS this is the whole saving: compression is not enabled, so the reduction ratio is absent by design.

panels.title: Snapshots
panels.description: Allocated bytes attributable to snapshots. 'My VM grew and I did nothing' is usually this.

panels.title: Filesystems
panels.description: Filesystems the guest agent reported, deduped by device.

panels.title: Per-filesystem usage
panels.description: Per mountpoint. A full / beside an empty /data averages to nothing, which is why this is not a single number.

panels.title: Disk usage over time
panels.description: The three numbers side by side. They measure different things and are deliberately not blended.

panels.title: Received by zone
panels.description: Bytes this VM received over the time range, by where the sender sits. Source: lachesis (eBPF on compute nodes).

targets.expr: (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (zone) ((clamp_min(lachesis_server_bytes_total{server_id=~"$UUID",direction="rx",zone!~"infra|miss|multicast"} - lachesis_server_bytes_total{server_id=~"$UUID",direction="rx",zone!~"infra|miss|multicast"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_server_bytes_total{server_id=~"$UUID",direction="rx",zone!~"infra|miss|multicast"})), "zone", "External", "zone", "external"), "zone", "Same tenant", "zone", "same_tenant"), "zone", "Other tenant", "zone", "other_tenant"), "zone", "Shared network", "zone", "shared") or label_replace(sum by () ((clamp_min(lachesis_server_bytes_total{server_id=~"$UUID",direction="rx",zone=~"infra|miss|multicast"} - lachesis_server_bytes_total{server_id=~"$UUID",direction="rx",zone=~"infra|miss|multicast"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_server_bytes_total{server_id=~"$UUID",direction="rx",zone=~"infra|miss|multicast"})), "zone", "Other", "", ""))

panels.title: Sent by zone
panels.description: Bytes this VM sent over the time range, by where the receiver sits. Source: lachesis (eBPF on compute nodes).

targets.expr: (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (zone) ((clamp_min(lachesis_server_bytes_total{server_id=~"$UUID",direction="tx",zone!~"infra|miss|multicast"} - lachesis_server_bytes_total{server_id=~"$UUID",direction="tx",zone!~"infra|miss|multicast"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_server_bytes_total{server_id=~"$UUID",direction="tx",zone!~"infra|miss|multicast"})), "zone", "External", "zone", "external"), "zone", "Same tenant", "zone", "same_tenant"), "zone", "Other tenant", "zone", "other_tenant"), "zone", "Shared network", "zone", "shared") or label_replace(sum by () ((clamp_min(lachesis_server_bytes_total{server_id=~"$UUID",direction="tx",zone=~"infra|miss|multicast"} - lachesis_server_bytes_total{server_id=~"$UUID",direction="tx",zone=~"infra|miss|multicast"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_server_bytes_total{server_id=~"$UUID",direction="tx",zone=~"infra|miss|multicast"})), "zone", "Other", "", ""))

panels.title: External received by network
panels.description: Bytes this VM received from outside the cloud, by external network. Source: lachesis (eBPF on compute nodes).

panels.title: External sent by network
panels.description: Bytes this VM sent outside the cloud, by external network. Source: lachesis (eBPF on compute nodes).

panels.title: Per port
panels.description: Bytes each of this VM's Neutron ports moved over the time range. Source: lachesis (eBPF on compute nodes).

panels.title: Traffic over time
panels.description: Bits per second of this VM, by direction and zone. Source: lachesis (eBPF on compute nodes).

targets.expr: 8 * label_replace(label_replace((label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (zone, direction) (rate(lachesis_server_bytes_total{server_id=~"$UUID",zone!~"infra|miss|multicast"}[$__rate_interval])), "zone", "External", "zone", "external"), "zone", "Same tenant", "zone", "same_tenant"), "zone", "Other tenant", "zone", "other_tenant"), "zone", "Shared network", "zone", "shared") or label_replace(sum by (direction) (rate(lachesis_server_bytes_total{server_id=~"$UUID",zone=~"infra|miss|multicast"}[$__rate_interval])), "zone", "Other", "", "")), "direction", "Sent", "direction", "tx"), "direction", "Received", "direction", "rx")
